title: The Snow Beacon That Changed Color
central_conflict: the mountain beacon appeared green from one trail and red from another
decisive_choice: a wedge of clear ice split the light differently across viewing angles
resolution: cleared the ice and added a protective hood while verifying both trails
story_beats: At the library courtyard, fox and rabbit discovered the mountain beacon appeared green from one trail and red from another during a power outage, leaving the community helpers waiting.
Rabbit tried to isolate the problem first, but they replaced its colored cover but the contradiction remained; fox stopped the attempt before further damage.
Fox compared the failed attempt with the evidence and realized a wedge of clear ice split the light differently across viewing angles; they planned a safer joint response.
With the community helpers watching, they cleared the ice and added a protective hood while verifying both trails, then explained the clue so their neighbors could prevent the problem next time.
